{{Quote|I am Shak'Weth, Blademaster here on Odacer-Faustin.|Shak'Weth|<ref name="RH" />}}
'''Shak'Weth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the [[Sith Blademaster|Blademaster]] of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding, during, and after the [[Great Galactic War]]. While all [[Sith apprentice/Legends|students]] were subject to his tutelage, he often gave private [[Sith training|training]] sessions to a young [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] named [[Rance Lussk]], the [[Sith academy|academy's]] premier apprentice. [[3645 BBY|Eight years]] after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a virulent [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|outbreak]] overtook the student populace of the [[Odacer-Faustin]] academy, and Shak'Weth prepared to depart as mayhem rapidly consumed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, just outside the academy, the Blademaster encountered a wandering [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Rojo Trace]], whom he proceeded to [[Duel on Odacer-Faustin|duel]]. When it seemed as though he would emerge victorious, Shak'Weth was unexpectedly attacked and viciously gored to [[Death/Legends|death]] by a victim of the plague: the [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated corpse]] of one of the very students he had trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].

==Biography==
===Blademaster===
{{Quote|I challenge Nickter.''"<br />"''&hellip;''"<br />"''Well, Nickter? What do you say?|Rance Lussk, a silent Wim Nickter, and Blademaster Shak'Weth|<ref name="RH" />}}
Shak'Weth was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="RH" /> who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resultant [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period of political unrest]].<ref name="Wars">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}} establishes that the [[Great Galactic War]] came to a close in [[3653 BBY]], while ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' states that the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed lasted at least ten years. [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']] takes place eight years after the Great War, indicating that the events of the novel occur during the Cold War.</ref> It was during that [[Time/Legends|time]] that Shak'Weth allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and eventually became both a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord of the Sith]]. He excelled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and was granted the coveted title of [[Sith Blademaster|Blademaster]], a distinction that saw his service given to the Empire in the form of instruction in his field of expertise on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="RH" /> The war effort against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ended in [[3653 BBY]] with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> at which point the Imperial war machine chose to accelerate rather than decrease its output of [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]] and leaders.<ref name="FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> Shak'Weth retained his decades-long position as [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] combat instructor of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]], and a measure of the Blademaster's wisdom was imparted to the enrolled learners.<ref name="RH" />

Shak'Weth's regimen consisted of [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of drill inside the [[Sith academy|academy]], followed by a trek up seventy-seven stairs to the roof for practice duels where the apprentices were armed with [[Poison/Legends|poison]] [[Pelko bug|barb-covered]] [[Sith training saber|training weapons]]. An especially skilled young Human adolescent named [[Rance Lussk]] showed exceptional promise, and Shak'Weth was among the many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Masters who granted him private instruction. On a day in [[3645 BBY]], after a group training lesson that left his students rather exhausted, Shak'Weth permitted them to engage in unrestricted practice combat for the first time. The highly-anticipated session commenced with a challenge&mdash;dreaded by his fellow students, nevertheless allowed by Shak'Weth&mdash;from Rance Lussk, wherein he beckoned forth the uncertain [[Wim Nickter]]. The Blademaster and his other students waited impatiently for the hesitant Nickter to accept or decline. When it became apparent that fear had stricken the apprentice, Shak'Weth demanded a response and was surprised by the boy's acceptance of his recognizably-superior opponent's summons. The Blademaster stood by silently alongside hundreds of other students as they all bore witness to the humiliating defeat subsequently suffered by Wim Nickter.<ref name="RH" />

===Jedi interloper===
{{Quote|You landed on the wrong world, Jedi. ''[&hellip;]'' I can only assume that you came here seeking humiliation and an unpleasant death.''"<br />"''I'm here on other matters.''"<br />"''Ah? But you've found me instead.|Shak'Weth and Rojo Trace|<ref name="RH" />}}
Not long afterward, an [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] experiment performed by the academy's headmaster, a Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] called [[Darth Scabrous]], resulted in the creation of a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] the bodies of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]]. As the malady spread throughout the school, all classes and drills&mdash;Shak'Weth's included&mdash;were canceled until further notice. While the rest of the faculty attempted to quell the epidemic, the Blademaster prepared to make haste his own flight. A chance encounter as he exited the academy forestalled his departure, however, when he caught sight of an approaching individual. As the man, whom Shak'Weth recognized as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], neared the building, the Sith Lord confronted him and declared that his unfortunate arrival on the Sith academy world would be rewarded with a painful death. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]], a Human named [[Rojo Trace]], obliged the Sith Lord's demand for penance, and [[Duel on Odacer-Faustin|combat]] ensued.<ref name="RH" />

Furious was Shak'Weth's advance upon the Jedi Knight, who was just barely able to evade the attack that carved a deep furrow into the ground where he had been standing a moment before. The Blademaster deflected his adversary's return slash and charged again, forcing the overmatched Trace into retreat as he narrowly avoided several erratic sweeps made by Shak'Weth's blade, each designed to [[Sai cha/Legends|sever]] the Jedi's head. Trace attempted a [[Form V/Legends|Form V: Djem So]]&ndash;inspired flip over the Sith Lord's head, followed by an attack that was effortlessly swatted aside, and was instead rewarded with a slash from Shak'Weth's lightsaber that opened a long wound across his chest. With his opponent wounded, Shak'Weth declared an imminent end to the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. However, as he braced himself against the outer wall of the academy, he dropped his lightsaber in surprise as [[Limb/Legends|hands]] emerged from a hole in the structure to seize him from behind by the [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. One of the undead victims of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Scabrous's plague had caught the Blademaster unawares and proceeded to gorge itself upon Shak'Weth's flesh as he struggled in futility to free himself. The teenage Sith zombie then dragged what remained of the helpless Blademaster through the hole to continue its feast, while Shak'Weth's Jedi opponent escaped with his life.<ref name="RH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Does Blademaster Shak'Weth know that you ran off with two of his toys?|Rance Lussk, concerned with the repercussions of touching Shak'Weth's training weapons without permission|<ref name="RH" />}}
Lord Shak'Weth, the preeminent lightsaber combatant and instructor on Odacer-Faustin, clad himself in [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a tunic, and a hooded [[Sith apparel|cloak]], from which he regarded those who sought to curry favor with him. His stern countenance and commanding voice identified him as at least a Sith Master by those to whom he was unfamiliar. Such was the [[prestige]] conveyed by Blademaster Shak'Weth and the other Masters upon Rance Lussk that the apprentice was allowed to only attend training sessions when he felt so inclined. Although other apprentices strove for perfection under the Blademaster's close scrutiny, he nonetheless witnessed the comings and goings of many whose ambition was also their undoing. Apprentices thought twice about even touching Shak'Weth's training sabers and questioned the boldness of those who did so without permission. Invigorated by the prospect of facing an opponent, the Sith Master grunted and snarled at his enemies with cordial contempt and indulged them with sinister smiles as he made promises of an ignominious death in combat.<ref name="RH" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Too easy, Jedi. Now I shall finish you.|Shak'Weth prepares to kill Rojo Trace|<ref name="RH" />}}
Shak'Weth was unparalleled on Odacer-Faustin in his mastery of the lightsaber, such that he was charged with the instruction of all of the academy's students in its use. He fought with a single [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed weapon and made use of blindingly-fast attacks and instantaneous responses to overwhelm his opponents. His battle presence was likened to a force of nature, another facet of the blizzards that ravaged Odacer-Faustin in perpetuity. Rojo Trace faced him and realized that, while the Blademaster politely guaranteed his demise, Shak'Weth's was a primal combat fury that ensured the utter destruction of his opponent as the only possible outcome. While immersed in the fight with the Jedi Rojo Trace, however, Shak'Weth was oblivious to his surroundings, a blunder that ultimately resulted in his death in the clutches of one of the Odacer-Faustin Sith zombies.<ref name="RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Joe Schreiber]] created Shak'Weth for the [[2010]] [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']] horror novel, the prequel to ''[[Death Troopers]]'', also penned by Schreiber. ''Red Harvest'' is Shak'Weth's first and only appearance to date.
